title: Understanding k-fold Cross Validation
text: Think about what happens when you increase the number of folds (k) in k-fold cross-validation. How does this affect the amount of data used for training versus testing in each fold?

title: Computational Intensity of Cross Validation
text: Consider the process of cross-validation. Does it involve training the model multiple times? How might this compare to a single train-test split in terms of computational resources?

title: Using the Entire Dataset
text: Reflect on how cross-validation utilizes the dataset. Does it allow for every data point to be used in both training and validation at some point?

title: Cross-validation in Production
text: Think about the purpose of cross-validation. Is it meant for model evaluation during development, or is it something that should be used when the model is deployed in a real-world setting?

title: Effect of Increasing k
text: What happens to the bias of the model when you increase k in k-fold cross-validation?

title: Computational Cost of Cross Validation
text: Is cross-validation less computationally intensive than regular validation?

title: Dataset Utilization in Cross Validation
text: Does cross-validation allow the entire training dataset to be used for testing the model?

title: Cross-validation in Production
text: Can cross-validation be used in production without the model "cheating" by looking at validation samples?
